title: Camera rental damage hold
naturalLanguageRequirements: A customer borrows a camera from a rental desk for a weekend and returns it on Monday. The source text does not say whether the desk collects money up front against damage.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Check out a camera

A customer borrows a camera for a weekend. Whether the desk collects money up front against damage is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Rental

The rental records the camera, the customer, and the return day.

# Constraints

## Return day

The camera is due back on Monday.

unresolvedSlots.question: Does the rental desk collect money up front against damage when the camera goes out?

alternatives.label: The desk places a refundable hold on the customer's card when the camera goes out.
The desk takes no money up front, and any damage is billed after the camera comes back.
